answer: Resist Sybils with synchronized live puzzles: each epoch, every identity must solve a human puzzle inside a short shared window, like spotting a lagoon in a nebula of images before the opal timer expires. Puzzles are generated only when the window opens, so answers cannot be precomputed or reused, and one person cannot attend many windows at once. A farmer running a thousand fakes must supply a thousand simultaneous human solvers every epoch, paying attention and wages each time, while a single honest agent pays only a few minutes. Automation fails the puzzle, and idle copies earn nothing.
